name: How are changes or new ideas handled once construction has started?

mainEntity.name: How are changes or new ideas handled once construction has started?

acceptedAnswer.text: Changes are documented as change orders, priced, and reviewed with you for approval before work proceeds, and the project manager updates the schedule and budget to reflect the revised scope.
